turns.input: *He looks at Bartolomhew, trying to understand what kind of person he has in front of him.*
turns.draft:
The man before Nicco in Heartstone Square was notably tall—perhaps a head taller than average—and his blond hair had turned extensively white. He kept a tonsure, and his elegant clothing still bore some clerical cues, though whether he was currently affiliated with any religious order was not immediately apparent. His face was pleasant enough, and he wore what seemed a practiced, paternal smile as he regarded the owner of the tower.

"I don't believe we've met," Bartolomhew said, his voice warm and measured. He made no move to approach closer, maintaining a comfortable distance on the open square. "I am Bartolomhew. A pleasure to make your acquaintance."

His gaze flicked briefly toward the massive wooden doors of Heartstone behind Nicco, then back to the man himself—the overweight figure with the white hairs and thinning scalp, standing without any visible weapons or equipment. The licensed slaver's smile did not waver, but his eyes held a certain appraising quality, the sort a man might wear when weighing whether an introduction might prove professionally useful.
